subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear John, Thank you for choosing FlyHigh Airlines for your upcoming trip. This email is to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th, 2022. Your flight details and e-ticket are attached for your reference. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The FlyHigh Airlines Team
